components.name: security-audit-skill
notes: Source of the phase model, the coverage ledger, report-schema.json and the two validators.
The validators reject every input on native Windows (O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK are undefined). kalkan ports them to Python.

components.name: sast-skills
notes: The upstream skills live in sast-files/.claude/skills. They are copied to skills/ so that Claude Code does not load them.
The upstream orchestration file sast-files/CLAUDE.md is renamed so that no agent host loads it.

components.name: codecrucible
notes: prompts/nano-analyzer is adapted by Block from weareaisle/nano-analyzer (Apache-2.0, AISLE).
The Go files are reference material for the Python ports of the quote verifier, the verdict policy and the finding identity.

components.name: deepsec
notes: The NOTICE file must ship with any redistribution (Apache-2.0 section 4(d)). kalkan repeats its text in the root NOTICE file.
Source of the 198 regex matchers, the declarative matcher spec with regex safety checks and the processor prompts.

components.name: open-code-review
notes: Source of the per-language rule documents (security sections) and the conservative review filter prompts.
Do not use the Alibaba or OpenCodeReview trademarks (Apache-2.0 section 6).

components.name: gitlab-sast-rules
components.license: MIT and LGPL-3.0-only (the license header of each file)
notes: Opengrep rule pack (ADR-0005, K.8). Copied: the rule files of csharp, java, javascript, python and scala (license header 'MIT (c) GitLab Inc.') and of rules/lgpl (license header 'GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0'; rules/lgpl/LICENSE is the LGPL-3.0 text). The test sources next to the rules are not copied (some carry the LGPL-3.0 header of find-sec-bugs).

Not copied: rules/lgpl-cc (LGPL-2.1 with the Commons Clause, which forbids selling services that derive their value from the rules), rules/gitlab (GitLab Enterprise Edition license, not open source), c (GPL-2.0 port of flawfinder, which kalkan runs itself), go (Apache-2.0 port of gosec, which kalkan runs itself), mappings, qa, ci and spec.

ADR-0005 and the 2026-10-19 research name the license 'LGPL-2.1'. The files say LGPL-3.0. The LGPL-3.0 adds permissions to the GPL-3.0, whose text is not in the upstream repository: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/gitlab (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py, docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md section 13).

components.name: 0xdea-semgrep-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack for C and C++ (ADR-0005, K.8). The C and C++ test sources next to the rules are not copied.
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/0xdea (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: trailofbits-semgrep-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack (ADR-0005, K.8; license policy of 2026-10-25: AGPL-3.0 rule files stay unmodified in their own folder with the license text, and kalkan is not offered as a network service). The test files next to the rules are not copied.
The pack belongs to the restricted group: KALKAN_RULE_PACKS=osi turns it off (docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md section 13).
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/trailofbits (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: elttam-semgrep-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack (ADR-0007). The test sources next to the rules (*.java, *.go, *.test.yaml and others) are not copied.
The upstream LICENSE names 'Copyright (c) 2020 Semgrep' (the line of the template that the repository started from); the MIT grant applies to the rules of elttam. kalkan repeats the LICENSE as it is.
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/elttam (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: mobsfscan-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack for Android (Java, Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) (ADR-0007). Only the Semgrep rules of mobsfscan/rules/semgrep; the regex patterns and the Python code are not copied. setup.py names the license 'LGPLv3+'.

Left out: the rule files whose header names Semgrep's semgrep-rules repository (no license before 2020-10-29, the Commons Clause after) or the GPL-3.0 mindedsecurity rules as their source (kalkan vendors the mindedsecurity rules as their own component).
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/mobsfscan (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: njsscan-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack for Node.js and Electron (ADR-0007). Only the Semgrep rules of njsscan/rules/semantic_grep; the regex patterns and the Python code are not copied. setup.py names the license 'LGPLv3+'.

Left out: the rule files whose header names Semgrep's semgrep-rules repository (no license before 2020-10-29, the Commons Clause after) or the GPL-3.0 mindedsecurity rules as their source (kalkan vendors the mindedsecurity rules as their own component).
GitLab sast-rules ports many njsscan rules (rules/lgpl/javascript); the build drops the repeats (duplicate check of scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/njsscan (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: atlassian-sast-ruleset
notes: Opengrep rule pack for Java enterprise frameworks (ADR-0007). COPYRIGHT names LGPL 2.1 ('version 2.1 of the License', without 'or later'); the repository has no Commons Clause.
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/atlassian (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: mindedsecurity-android-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack for Android, by OWASP MASTG test (ADR-0007). The LICENSE is the GPL-3.0 text, and the repository names no 'or later' option. The rule files stay unmodified in their own folder with the license text; the bundles in rules/opengrep-packs/mindedsecurity are GPL-3.0 too.
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/mindedsecurity (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: aikido-opengrep-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack for GitHub Actions and npm publishing (ADR-0007).
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/aikido (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: semgrep-codeql-rules
notes: Opengrep rules converted from the security queries of https://github.com/github/codeql (MIT, Copyright (c) 2006-2025 GitHub, Inc.) by Andrew Nesbitt with an LLM (README). The rules have no tests upstream, so kalkan keeps only the rules that it measured on tests/fixtures/vulnapp (keep_only in rules/opengrep-packs/curation.json, ADR-0007). kalkan repeats the GitHub copyright notice in the root NOTICE.
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/semgrep-codeql (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).
